description: This source file defines a frontend component for displaying product details in a shopping app, using LightningJS framework. It manages product display, updates based on store state, and includes interactivity to add items to the cart.

classes.name: ProductDetail
classes.description: A LightningJS component for displaying detailed information about a product.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds the current product to the shopping cart via AppStore.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, loads products if necessary, and sets the current product based on provided ID.
